titel: I Don’t Need AI in My Toothbrush

faehigkeiten.grund: Auslieferung wird je Abruf neu zusammengesetzt (megaphone vergibt je Abruf eine request_event_id, megaphone haengt ein timetoken an, Adresse traegt eine session_id, kein ETag und Cache-Control "max-age=0, no-cache, no-store", Abruf laeuft ueber den Werbedienst megaphone.fm) - Byte-Offsets veralten (bei dynamischer Auslieferung sofort, gemessen 19.08.2026) und die Zeitachse verschiebt sich mit (eine Folge war 57 s kuerzer als 3,5 h zuvor), deshalb sind auch Sprungmarken in Sekunden unsicher

einzeiler: A deep dive into YouTube view inflation, GoPro's wild week, and new tech gadgets.
kurzfassung: The hosts discuss YouTube's controversial new metric system for views and the chaotic recent news surrounding GoPro. They also explore Google's new Android tracking and feature updates, Sonos's latest audio gear and AI integrations, and Dyson's controversial toothbrush. The episode wraps up with a tech-focused show and tell segment and their regular trivia game.
stichpunkte: YouTube's transition to engaged views causes massive view counts and dashboard confusion for creators.
The GoPro and Markiplier situation sparks debate over sponsorship disclosures and tech review ethics.
Google's Android feature drop introduces tracking for un-tagged items and car sickness mitigation.
Sonos announces the Sonos Ace Ultra headphones and Sonos OS with heavy AI agent integration.
Dyson launches a $499 toothbrush equipped with a low-res camera and a water-jet flossing system.
Operation Bluebird attempts to revive the Twitter name through a new paid social media platform.
The hosts showcase various gadgets during show and tell, including a portable fitness cable machine and a travel watch.

clips.text: A popular video accumulates twice as many public views as engaged views, making performance metrics confusing.

clips.hook: A YouTuber as a major corporate shareholder
clips.text: A massive content creator unexpectedly acquires a substantial percentage of a major camera company's stock.

clips.hook: A toothbrush with a 0.1 megapixel camera
clips.text: A high-end dental device uses a very low-resolution camera to monitor teeth and automatically spray mouthwash.
A new company attempts to reclaim the classic social media bird branding with a subscription fee.

clips.hook: Radio app banned in certain countries
clips.text: An interactive global radio streaming map is legally unavailable in specific regions due to copyright laws.

beschreibung:
This week, Marques, Andrew, and David jump right into it by discussing the differences in YouTube views now that Viewflation has been happening for a full week. After that, it's all about GoPro, Markiplier, and what a "review" actually means. Then they talk about some new Android features before getting into the new AI Dyson toothbrush. We wrap it all up with some show and tell and trivia!
